answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance emerges from falcon-like observers that continuously sample a dense nebula of peer-to-peer compute traces. Each agent must periodically deposit a unique crystal of zero-knowledge proof derived from private hardware entropy; the falcons verify these crystals against the nebula's cumulative density, making mass identity forgery prohibitively costly because fabricating consistent crystal histories across the entire nebula requires exponential coordination that honest participants never need.
